name: Should I choose a pre-hung or slab door for replacement?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose a pre-hung or slab door for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between a pre-hung door and a slab door depends on your existing door frame's condition and the project scope. A pre-hung door comes pre-assembled in its own frame and is generally easier to install if your existing frame is damaged, misaligned, or you're creating a new opening. Slab doors are just the door panel itself, ideal when your existing frame is in excellent condition and perfectly plumb. A pre-hung option typically offers a more consistent fit but may require more work to remove the old frame. We assess your opening to advise the best choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a pre-hung door if your frame is damaged or for new openings; choose a slab door if your existing frame is sound and plumb.
